# awscc_networkmonitor_probe (Resource)

An Amazon CloudWatch Network Monitor probe that measures network traffic between a source subnet and a destination.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) The literal IPv4 or IPv6 address the probe sends traffic to. The service rejects a domain name and a CIDR block.
- `monitor_name` (String) The name of the monitor the probe belongs to.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol the probe uses.
- `source_arn` (String) The ARN of the subnet the probe sends traffic from.

### Optional

- `destination_port` (Number) The port the probe sends traffic to. Applies to the TCP protocol only.
- `packet_size` (Number) The size, in bytes, of the packets the probe sends.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags for the probe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `address_family` (String) The IP address family the probe uses, computed by the service from the source and destination.
- `created_at` (String) The time and date when the probe was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `modified_at` (String) The time and date when the probe was last modified.
- `probe_arn` (String) The ARN of the probe.
- `probe_id` (String) The ID of the probe.
- `state` (String) The state of the probe.
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC containing the probe's source subnet.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkmonitor_probe.example
  identity = {
    monitor_name = "monitor_name"
    probe_id     = "probe_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `monitor_name` (String) The name of the monitor the probe belongs to
- `probe_id` (String) The ID of the probe

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkmonitor_probe.example
  id = "monitor_name|probe_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_networkmonitor_probe.example "monitor_name|probe_id"
```
